lines: Saitou Hanjirou
「Shit...... I can't believe I, of all people.........」
He had pushed himself a little too hard in escaping from the back alley.
It appeared that his stomach wound had opened again.
The blood he had hemorrhaged was already reaching his feet.
The insides of his leather shoes were sopping with blood, making a sound like he was stepping in mud when he walked.
Even if he pressed down on his stomach with his hand, he couldn't hold back the bleeding anymore.
He had to get medical attention somewhere, quickly.
And, he had to eliminate that man.
However, it was almost evening.
The downtown sector was starting to swarm with herde that had just finished work.
Saitou Hanjirou
Honestly. They couldn't help but get in his way.
Middle-Aged Man
「U-Um, are you injured? Are you all right? Should I call an ambulance or something?」
A middle-aged man with a wrinkled suit, the kind of guy whose sole joy was having a beer with his dinner, had called out to him with a dimwitted face.
Saitou Hanjirou
It was immediately clear just by looking at Saitou that he was injured, and wasn't all right.
On top of which, he hadn't called an ambulance because he had reason enough not to.
For this man to be unable to even think that far, ask him stupid questions, and, on top of that, block his path...
Saitou Hanjirou
「You're in the way! Step aside!!」
Saitou unthinkingly sprouted arms and pushed the man away.
Middle-Aged Man
「Wh-Whoa?! Did his arms just... Eh? Eh? What?」
The middle-aged man had clumsily fallen down, making a puzzled-looking face.
The surrounding herde also noticed him, and started to make a pointless racket, with things like 「Blood's coming out of him,」 and 「He's wounded.」
Saitou Hanjirou
「Damn herde!!」
Saitou spat out.
And then, he thought,
“Anyway, I need to know the ninja art of my enemy!”
“Of that piece of shit, Igawa Kageomi or whatever!”
Jiwaah―――
Saitou Hanjirou
「Kuhh!」
It was probably because he had shouted at the man. Blood had flooded from his abdomen again.
Saitou Hanjirou
「This wound is...... punishment for my negligence. It's part of the process for me becoming the ubermensch......」
He told himself, and was about to start walking, when that moment,
Saitou Hanjirou
He was struck by an intense murderous aura.
Saitou Hanjirou
He reflexively fell flat on the ground, then and there.
Gagagagagagagagagahh!!
High-pitched gunshots rang out.
The herde who had been walking around him collapsed in droves.
Gagagagagagagagagagah!!
The ones shooting were Drone Dogs.
It was probably that Kageomi controlling them.
They had fired at Saitou.
In the middle of the street, where the herde were coming and going.
All over the place, blood sprayed and screams arose, and the street instantly transformed into a scene of carnage.
Saitou Hanjirou
「Is that man insane?!」
Middle-Aged Man
「Wh-Wh-What is that?! A robot?! S-S-Someone help me―――Ugyaaah!!」
Even the middle-aged man who had just talked to him voluntarily stood up, and got shot.
It was a fitting death for his stupidity.
Saitou Hanjirou
「Tch.」
It would be difficult to fight in the streets like this.
But, fortunately, the people who had panicked were taking it upon themselves to move around, and serve as shields for him.
While watching from the side as the herde, who only wanted happiness in their daily lives, were killed, Saitou crawled along, and continued his escape.
